question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -10 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 8 \\ -20\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{b}_{1}+{x}_{2}{b}_{2} & =x \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -10 \\ 6\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 8 \\ -20\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The equation above gives the system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 10 \\ 4 & -10 & 8 \\ -2 & 6 & -20\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 10 \\ 4 & -10 & 8 \\ -2 & 6 & -20\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 10 \\ 0 & 2 & -32 \\ -2 & 6 & -20\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & 10 \\ 0 & 2 & -32 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=10 \\ 2{x}_{2}=-32.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get ${x}_{2}=-16.$ Substituting this into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}-3(-16)=10\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=-38.
$$

Therefore, $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-38 \\ -16\end{aligned}].$

Finally, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-38)+(-16)=-54.$
